article.headline: Dye has 21, Abilene Christian takes down Southwestern Adventist 87-68
article.description: — Isaac Dye had 21 points in Abilene Christian’s 87-68 win against Southwestern Adventist on Saturday.
article.linkText: Dye has 21, Abilene Christian takes down Southwestern Adventist 87-68

keywords: Southwestern Adventist Knights @ Abilene Christian Wildcats
article.story: ABILENE, Texas -- — Isaac Dye had 21 points in Abilene Christian’s 87-68 win against Southwestern Adventist on Saturday. Dye had five rebounds for the Wildcats (3-3). Willan Marie-Anais added 18 points while shooting 6 of 8 from the field and 6 for 8 from the line while he also had seven rebounds. Xabi Lopez had 11 points and went 5 of 6 from the field. Jordan Poole finished with 26 points, four assists and two steals for the Knights. Andre Guajardo Mancilla added 20 points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
